beats.text: Two branches, one history. Which way do you combine them?
Merge says: keep both stories, add a snapshot of them together.
That snapshot is a merge commit. Honest, but noisy.
Rebase says: replay your work on top, as if you started last.
Clean straight line. But rewriting shared history breaks your team.
So: merge in public. Rebase in private.

scenes.caption: one main line · commits land one by one
a feature branch grows out of main
